purpose: Mid-training ANNEAL stage (plan.md §2): low-LR 1-sqrt cooldown FROM the faithful base on the premium 50/50 mix (treatment) vs an iso-token fineweb-only control. Isolates 'premium data seen last under a cooldown' from 'the LR decay + more tokens'. Headline = treatment_BPB - control_BPB on code_py; honest null expected on English/downstream.
single_variable: DATA only: treatment=mix vs control=fineweb-only, identical base + cooldown schedule + ~150M-tok budget + 3 seeds. The matched-decay control is non-negotiable (§2): it eats the LR-decay/more-tokens gain, only the residual is a data effect.
recipe: 1-sqrt cooldown peak_lr 2.5e-4 -> end_lr 2.5e-5 (10% floor), warmup 46, 2300 steps x 65,536 tok = 150.7M tok/cell (~13% of 1.19B pretrain), mb4 x ga4, AdamW(0.9,0.95) wd 0.01, bf16 seq 4096, chunked fp32 CE, compile on.

smoke.detail: INIT-FROM base strict load OK (596M params); starting CE 3.418 (= converged base loss, NOT random ~6.3); cooldown LR 2.5e-4->2.5e-5 verified; mix data 50/50 assembled; ckpt save@2 + exit 0. weights_only=False bug caught+fixed in smoke.

probe.source: mb4+compile data-mix mix_seed0 (identical trainer/config); under §C5 60% margin AND the 0.83 kill line

verdict_metric: score_cohort.py BPB on wikitext2+code_py per checkpoint; verdict.py treatment-vs-control 3-seed Welch-t CI (must exclude control to claim a data effect); short-context non-regression. Expected: small code-BPB win only; null on English/downstream (pre-registered honest null, §C25).
